items.context: @Cointelegraph (2.925.295 seguidores), en inglés: "ALERT: Bitcoin options traders are betting on further price declines at levels not seen since June 2022, when BTC was trading near $20,000, per Glassnode." Publicado hace ~1 h: 92 likes, 37 respuestas, 22.575 vistas. Debate del precio de BTC; ángulo: posicionamiento en opciones vs. Market Temperature.
items.suggested_text:
Put demand this heavy tells you more about positioning than about direction. When traders pay up for downside at levels last seen near $20K in 2022, it means fear is already priced into the hedges, and crowded protection has a habit of becoming fuel when the expected drop doesn't come fast enough.

Valuation is telling a similar story from another angle. My Market Temperature index, which blends MVRV, price vs the 200-week average, drawdown from the high and volatility-adjusted 90-day momentum, went from 99.29 to 0.67 in 364 days: https://x.com/ForecastQuant/status/2122727211610542288

Cold readings and one-sided hedging don't mark a bottom on their own. But the market rarely gives its best entries when the options board looks comfortable, does it?
